VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that acceptance criteria have been met. While the report claims all 64 tests pass and describes reasonable technical work (switching to integer cents, adding regression tests), there is no independent evidence to corroborate these claims. The absence of CI logs, test output, diffs, or any externally-verifiable artifacts means the claims cannot be independently validated. For a production-ready fix affecting billing, objective evidence (CI/CD records, test reports, code review artifacts) is required, not self-attestation.
